gold.min_shared: 10% of windows, at least 1, at most 3

meta.dataset: PatronusAI/financebench, CC BY-NC 4.0 (question text left out here)

keyword.text: Chunk.embed_text (filing/section/page header + content), the text the embedding model sees
keyword.terms: Postgres english text search; a chunk matches on any question term
keyword.query: FinanceBench question verbatim, each term weighted by its count in it
keyword.statistics: N, df, avgdl over the whole corpus, also when filtered
keyword.ties: score rounded to 9 decimals, then md5(id)

fusion.ranks: 1-based; equal scores within a leg share a rank
fusion.ties: better vector rank, then better keyword rank, then md5(id)
fusion.legs: run one after the other; search_ms is their sum
